title: रावण नाम कैसे पड़ा
sources: Valmiki Ramayana, Uttara Kanda 9: born to the sage Vishrava and Kaikasi with ten heads, the child is named Dashagriva by his father
Valmiki Ramayana, Uttara Kanda 14-15: Dashagriva defeats his half-brother Kubera (Vaishravana) and takes the Pushpaka vimana

Valmiki Ramayana, Uttara Kanda 16.1-16: over the Sharavana forest, near the mountain where Shiva sports, the Pushpaka stops moving; Nandishvara, Shiva's attendant (described as dark, dwarfish, monkey-faced), tells him to turn back; Dashagriva laughs at his monkey face; Nandi curses him that monkeys of his own form and strength will destroy his race

Valmiki Ramayana, Uttara Kanda 16.17-27: in anger he thrusts his arms under the mountain and lifts it; the mountain shakes, Parvati clings to Shiva; Shiva, as if in play, presses the mountain down with his big toe, crushing his arms; he lets out a terrible cry that shakes the three worlds

Valmiki Ramayana, Uttara Kanda 16.28-39: on his ministers' advice he praises Shiva with hymns, weeping, for a thousand years; Shiva, pleased, frees his arms and says: since you made the three worlds cry out in fear (ravita), your name will be Ravana
Valmiki Ramayana, Uttara Kanda 16.43: Shiva also gives him the sword Chandrahasa
Popular / later tradition (not in Valmiki): Ravana composed the Shiva Tandava Stotram while pinned under the mountain. Said in the reel with मान्यता है and contrasted with Valmiki
Nandi's curse fulfilled by Rama's vanara army: Uttara Kanda 16 (curse) with the war in Yuddha Kanda

lines.text: क्या आप जानते हैं, कि रावण नाम, खुद भगवान शिव ने दिया था?

lines.text: जन्म के समय उसके दस सिर थे, इसलिए पिता विश्रवा ने नाम रखा, दशग्रीव।
